name: @402flow/sdk-third-party-executors
description: Repo-local third-party executor adapters and proofs for @402flow/sdk.

scripts.build: npm --prefix .. run build && npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const path of ['dist', 'tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo', 'tsconfig.typecheck.tsbuildinfo']) { fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true }); }"
scripts.lint: eslint src test vitest.config.ts && npm run typecheck
